title: Fix knowledge corpus integrity issues
summary: Fixes broken references and mismatched examples in BCQuality skill documentation and limits DataTransfer, teaching-tip and 'this' articles to the Business Central versions that support them. It also restores a missing article title and lets the root-entry guard accept .claude-plugin/. The knowledge and findings contracts are unchanged.
key_points: Dead knowledge and sample references in skill documentation were replaced with canonical current articles
Articles for DataTransfer, teaching-tips, and this keyword guidance were scoped to Business Central versions that support these features
Missing title was restored on SetSelectionFilter article and root-entry guard updated to recognize .claude-plugin/
Content validator confirms no errors or warnings remain
All internal references now resolve and JSON examples parse successfully
quote: Broken references and mismatched examples made BCQuality's own skill documentation cite rules that do not exist
